name: Tuna Tossed Salad with Avocado, Artichoke, Tomato, Cucumber & Croutons

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 avocados
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the parsley. Add mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Drain tuna and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and cooled croutons, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
